collector_notes: Pack built live on 2026-09-23 (session-2 addendum), not on the nominal 2026-09-19 census date; collected_at is kept at the battery-wide 2026-09-19 convention per every other pack in this directory, and every field below carries its own real as_of/fetched_at so the skew is auditable. Crest Ventures earns its hostile_traits label in full: it is BOTH an NBFC (financial-services taxonomy) AND a real-estate developer carrying projects on its own balance sheet, and standalone vs consolidated figures diverge hard (P/E 46-49 standalone vs 29-31 consolidated; ROE 2.1-3.5% standalone vs 3.75% consolidated; book value INR415 standalone vs INR459 consolidated) - a pipeline that silently picks one basis will show a materially different company. THREE independent live sources (screener.in, api.bseindia.com's own ComHeadernew feed, stockanalysis.com) disagree with each other on P/E, EPS-TTM, ROE, PB, day's high/low and 52-week high for the SAME instrument on the SAME day - each is individually legitimate (different EPS-TTM windows / rounding / live vs delayed feed), so these are recorded as multi-source disagreements, not as one side being wrong. bseindia.com's public HTML pages 403 automated fetchers as documented in COMMON.md, but api.bseindia.com's JSON endpoints (DefaultData, ComHeadernew, getScripHeaderData, AnnSubCategoryGetData) all answered with a browser UA + bseindia.com Referer, and several confirm first-party facts (ISIN, exact dividend ex-dates, exact results-filing timestamp) that screener.in only implies.

consolidated_vs_standalone.note: This is the single most load-bearing fact in the pack. Crest Ventures reports BOTH standalone and consolidated financials (screener.in serves them as two distinct URLs, /company/511413/ vs /company/511413/consolidated/, with no default indicated in the page itself), and they diverge materially: consolidated revenue TTM (~INR126cr) is ~1.45x standalone (~INR87cr); consolidated net profit TTM (~INR33cr) is ~1.57x standalone (~INR21cr); consolidated P/E (~29-31x) is roughly two-thirds of standalone P/E (~46-49x); consolidated book value (INR459) exceeds standalone (INR415) by ~11%. The gap is exactly what the manifest's hostile_traits predicts: the SPV/JV real-estate structure shows up in the consolidated numbers and is largely invisible standalone. Any in-app value for this symbol MUST be diffed against the matching basis (standalone vs consolidated), never against 'whichever screener page loaded first' - a diff that mixes bases will manufacture a false mismatch on almost every P&L-derived ratio.

BSE's OWN two live JSON endpoints (getScripHeaderData vs StockReachGraph) disagree with each other on the SAME day's high/low (385.90/361.05 vs 390/360) - 'first-party' does not mean 'internally consistent'.

The trailing-12-month declared-dividend figure is boundary-sensitive: the 2025-09-23 ex-date dividend sits exactly one year before today's fetch (2026-09-23), so 'paid_trailing_12m_per_share' is either INR2.00 or INR1.00 depending on an inclusive/exclusive boundary choice that no source makes explicit.
